image_description: A Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) resting on a bed of smooth, multi-colored river stones. The crab is viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing its broad oval carapace and walking legs tucked close to the body. The lighting appears natural, casting soft shadows among the rocks.
